title: Credit Policy History Clause — Reconnection Look-Back on Electric Service by Rate Schedule Accounts
content:
**Clause.** The reconnection look-back is the span over which the earlier reconnections of an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account are counted, by the reconnect fees dated in it. Its starting event depends on the account's collection record: its Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements) record and its returned payments.

| Collection record of the service account | Reconnect fees counted in the look-back |
|---|---|
| The account's payment arrangement is defaulted, with an ended date less than twelve whole months before the current date | Every reconnect fee since the account's connect date: the look-back runs the whole months elapsed since the connect date, the month in progress counted, so it covers the reconnect fees dated less than one more than that number of whole months before the current date |
| No such defaulted arrangement, and a returned payment is dated less than twelve whole months before the current date | The reconnect fees since the latest returned payment: the look-back runs the whole months elapsed since that return's posting date, the month in progress counted, so it covers the reconnect fees dated less than one more than that number of whole months before the current date |
| Any other case | The reconnect fees dated less than 12 whole months before the current date |

### Hypothetical cases (current date 2026-09-10)

| Arrangement | Latest returned payment | Look-back |
|---|---|---|
| Defaulted, ended 2026-02-01 | 2026-05-03 | From the connect date: an account connected 2014-06-20 has 146 whole months elapsed, so fees dated less than 147 whole months before the current date are counted |
| Defaulted, ended 2025-06-30 (more than twelve whole months before) | 2026-05-03 | 4 whole months since the return, so fees dated less than 5 whole months before the current date |
| None | None in the twelve months | Fees dated less than 12 whole months before the current date |

### Points of reading

- The arrangement read is the payment arrangement of the same service account; a defaulted arrangement whose ended date is twelve whole months or more before the current date does not anchor the look-back.
- The returned payment that anchors the look-back is the latest one on the account.
